headline: Brown & Brown’s Q2 Earnings Call: Our Top 5 Analyst Questions

headline: JP Morgan Maintains Neutral on Brown & Brown, Raises Price Target to $80
summary: JP Morgan  analyst Pablo Singzon   maintains Brown & Brown (NYSE:BRO) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $78 to $80.
